name: Cheap First
description: Answers questions and writing requests at a fraction of the usual cost. Dolphin's low-cost model answers first, SERV Reasoning checks the answer, and a premium model steps in only when the check fails. In a 143-question benchmark it cost 80% less than always using the premium model, with the same quality.
